rows.title: Citi doubles the Cash Back card's joining bonus to AED 300 — same AED 6,000 spend condition | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Citibank UAE has raised the welcome credit on its Cash Back Credit Card from AED 150 to AED 300, with the qualifying spend unchanged at AED 6,000 in 60 days. The direct-application restriction still applies, and it is the restriction most people trip over.

rows.title: The DubaiPoints news desk is open | DubaiPoints
rows.description: DubaiPoints starts filing UAE-resident points-and-miles news, regulation changes, card launches and salary-transfer offer movements — AED-first, with sources cited inline.

rows.title: Emirates Islamic pays banded salary-transfer cashback to 30 September — unless you've banked with ENBD lately | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Emirates Islamic's salary-transfer cashback runs to 30 September 2026: AED 50–3,000 in account cashback by salary band for expats plus up to AED 1,000 in Covered Card spend rewards. The new-to-Group rule, the enrolment form and the lowest-month banding are the fine print that decides who actually gets paid.

rows.title: Emirates Islamic extends the Switch Cashback welcome offer to 30 September | DubaiPoints
rows.description: The AED 500 welcome cashback on Emirates Islamic's Switch Cashback Card — AED 15,000 of retail spend within 60 days of approval — now runs to 30 September 2026. Confirmed against the bank's card page in our July verification pass.

rows.title: Emirates Skywards opens 'Season of Rewards': Cash+Miles doubles, bonus tier miles through August | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Emirates Skywards' summer campaign (21 May–31 August 2026) bundles four member offers. For UAE residents the doubled Cash+Miles rate is the broadly useful one; the rest are situational and come with a registration step and a hard travel-completion deadline.

rows.title: ENBD's bonus-interest salary transfer: 5% to 6% on AED 25,000 for six months, explained in AED | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Emirates NBD's 1 February – 30 June 2026 cycle pays bonus interest on a salary-transfer balance instead of a fixed cash sum. Here's what it actually pays in AED, who clears the gates, and how it compares to a cash-bonus cycle.

rows.title: Etihad fare sale closes 31 July 2026 — and its Miles prices value an Etihad Guest Mile at a flat 2.94 fils | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Etihad's UAE offers page carries round-trip Economy fares ex-Abu Dhabi with a book-by-31-July deadline for travel to November 2026. Each fare shows a cash price and an Etihad Guest Miles price; divide one by the other and every route returns 2.94 fils per Mile.

rows.title: Etihad's Miles-as-cash rate is a constant, not a promotion: 2.94 fils across two consecutive sales | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Etihad's new 'Last chance for summer' sale prices six European and North African routes in cash and Miles side by side. Every one divides to 2.94 fils per Mile — the identical rate its July sale returned on a completely different route list. That makes it a standing setting, not a per-sale decision, and it stays a poor use of Miles.

rows.title: UAE hotel & loyalty news | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Hotel-loyalty news for UAE residents: Marriott Bonvoy and hotel-programme changes, promotions and UAE property openings, with original denominations and source links.

rows.title: IHG's pick-your-points promotion ends 31 August — nine days to register, and which option you pick is night-count arithmetic | DubaiPoints
rows.description: IHG One Rewards' Choice Promotion — register for either 2,000 points every 2 nights or 8,000 points every 4 nights, both uncapped — covers stays through 31 August 2026. Registration must come before the stay, and the right pick depends entirely on how many IHG nights you have left this month.

rows.title: Marriott Bonvoy is paying 5,000 points for one stay under the Skywards partnership — register before you check in | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Link your Marriott Bonvoy and Emirates Skywards accounts, register, and complete one eligible paid stay between 15 July and 30 September 2026 to collect 5,000 bonus Bonvoy points — AED 125 at our cost-basis baseline. Registration must come before the stay.

rows.title: Mashreq Cashback rate cut: fuel, utilities, government and telecom fall to 0.15% on 13 June 2026 | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Mashreq's published notice confirms a category-rate cut effective 13 June 2026 on the Cashback Credit Card — government, utilities, education, charity, fuel, rental and telecom drop from 0.33% to 0.15%. The 5% on dining, 1% on other UAE/international spend, and the AED 5 monthly free bill payment all stay.

rows.title: May 2026 welcome cycles end at FAB, RAKBANK, HSBC and Emirates Islamic — what changed, what to watch for | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Four UAE issuers closed their May 2026 welcome cycles on 31 May. We've reframed every affected review on the site. Here's the cycle-end summary — what each cycle paid, what readers who already applied are owed, and what the next cycle is likely to look like.

rows.title: RAKBANK's AED 4,000 salary-transfer cash reward closes 31 August — the first salary has to land by then | DubaiPoints
rows.description: RAKBANK's no-credit-card-required salary-transfer cash reward — up to AED 4,000 — ends 31 August 2026, and the qualifying first salary must arrive inside the window. Both prior RAKBANK cycles vanished from the site after close, so there is no promised successor to wait for.

rows.title: Skywards' Season of Rewards ends 31 August — and you must fly by then, not just book | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Nine days remain in Emirates Skywards' summer campaign. The deadline that bites is the travel window: tickets must be booked, issued and flown (outbound) by 31 August 2026. Partner bonuses stay capped at 10,000 Miles per partner, and new members must enrol by 11.59pm Dubai time on the 31st.

rows.title: Skywards' summer redemption push runs to 30 September — and its DSS raffle offers 5 million Miles to 30 August | DubaiPoints
rows.description: Emirates Skywards has enhanced its non-flight redemption rates until 30 September, with Skywards Everyday converting 350 Miles into AED 10 back. A parallel Dubai Summer Surprises raffle gives 500 members 10,000 Miles each on AED 200+ spend through 30 August.
